goal: Fix Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1's default -QueueRoot derivation so it lands correctly regardless of whether -PmcroRoot is relative or absolute, and verify the fix live against both cases without polluting real trail/queue state.

steps.action: Read plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/scripts/Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1's default -QueueRoot derivation and fix it: instead of re-deriving from the raw -PmcroRoot string via two Split-Path -Parent calls plus a hardcoded '.pmcro\queue' literal (which only happens to work when -PmcroRoot is exactly the relative string '.\.pmcro'), derive QueueRoot by walking two Split-Path -Parent levels up from the already-resolved $trailDir (which is correct in both the -PmcroRoot+-TrailId and the -TrailPath call shapes) and Join-Path the result with 'queue' -- no hardcoded '.pmcro' segment. Preserve the explicit -QueueRoot override path unchanged.

Verify the fix live, without touching real trail/queue state: mint a disposable scratch trail via pmcro-trail's New-Trail.ps1 -OutputPath (a temp/scratchpad location, not .pmcro/trails), drive it to having a CheckFrame (minimal plan/make/check calls suffice), then invoke the fixed Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 twice against that scratch trail via -TrailPath: once with an absolute custom -PmcroRoot value different from CWD, confirming the queue item lands under that root's queue/ folder; once reproducing the original default-relative-path case, confirming no regression. Delete all scratch trail/queue artifacts afterward.

Independently re-inspect the diff to Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 and re-run (or re-derive by hand) both verification cases from step 2 -- absolute -PmcroRoot and default relative -PmcroRoot -- confirming each queue item actually landed in the expected folder and that no leftover scratch artifacts remain in the repo's real .pmcro/trails or .pmcro/queue; append one CheckFrame with a PASS/FAIL verdict per criterion and overall.

Close the cycle: record a Reflection with a disposition reflecting whether the QueueRoot derivation bug is actually fixed and verified, then seal the trail. No further seed expected unless verification in step 3 found the fix incomplete.

success_criteria: Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1's default QueueRoot derivation no longer re-parses the raw -PmcroRoot string with a hardcoded '.pmcro\queue' literal; it derives from the already-resolved trail directory, or the caller supplies -QueueRoot explicitly.

A live invocation of the fixed script with an absolute -PmcroRoot (different from the working directory) writes its queue item under that same root's queue/ folder -- not the drive root or any other unrelated location.

A live invocation of the fixed script with the original default relative -PmcroRoot ('.\.pmcro', CWD at repo root) still writes its queue item under the repo's real .pmcro/queue/ folder -- no regression versus prior behavior.
No scratch or test artifacts created during verification remain in the repo's real .pmcro/trails or .pmcro/queue directories afterward.
out_of_scope: Changing the queue-item schema or the Reflection/PlanFrame schemas.
Fixing or re-litigating the separate success_criteria-scoping issue filed as task-scope-success-criteria-to-check-time-evaluable-facts -- that is a different queued task.
Any change to New-Trail.ps1, New-OrchestrateFrame.ps1, New-PlanFrame.ps1, New-MakeStep.ps1, or New-CheckFrame.ps1 -- only Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1's QueueRoot derivation is in scope.
